Concordance issues

180 errors · 957 warnings · 23,691 clean-up · 5,109 for review · built 2026-09-24 from commit 5e116ee

Work from
The concordance990 repository (GitHub main). Not the v1 repository, and not concordance.csv or concordance.xlsx, which are generated.
Edit
The component tables in inst/extdata/src/. Each case below names the file, the row (its key) and the column.
Log
After editing, run devtools::load_all(); draft_changes(author = "...", write = TRUE), then fill in reason and evidence in inst/extdata/changelog/changes.csv.
Rebuild
Rscript data-raw/build-concordance.R, then devtools::test(). When a structural rule improves, lower its ceiling in inst/extdata/validation/rule_ceilings.csv.
990-PF
PF cases point to the v1 file F990-PF-FULL.CSV because the PF concordance is not yet in the v2 component tables. Fix them after the PF merge (Phase 5) so the fixes are logged.
Accepting a case
If a flagged case is correct as it is, record that in the validation log (Phase 4) instead of changing data.

Evidence

  • Component tables: structural rules on inst/extdata/src (the v1 baseline, unchanged so far)
  • 990 / 990-EZ filings: ef2 DuckDB builds, tax years 2009-2024, 5,981,036 filings (evidence built 2026-09-23 17:09:04 MST)
  • 990-PF filings: one ef2pf DuckDB build (EFILEPF2023.duckdb), 114,559 filings; compared with the v1 PF concordance
  • Judgement thresholds: flags and value checks use the thresholds stated in each section; errors are cases where the evidence points to a mapping or data defect

Summary

Errors are likely mapping or data defects; warnings need judgement; clean-up items are mechanical; review items are context. Every case, one per row, is in issues.csv.

⚠ error COLLISION Two xpaths of one variable filled in the same filing

Why it fails. In the listed number of filings, two or more of the variable's xpaths carry values at the same time. A parser keeps one and drops the rest, and it usually means two different form lines were pooled (e.g. book value and fair market value).

How to fix. Move the extra xpath(s) to their own variable: xpaths.csv variable_name (remap) plus a new row in variables.csv; add a families.csv row if they are alternates of one line. affects_data TRUE.

⚠ error R07 Each variable belongs to exactly one table

Why it fails. A variable is one column in one table. v1 assigns some xpaths of these variables to other tables (xpath_overrides.csv, field rdb_table), so the same column name appears in several tables.

How to fix. Decide the variable's table. Delete the rdb_table override rows to use the variable's table (resolve_conflict), or split the xpaths into a new variable in the other table (xpaths.csv variable_name, variables.csv new row; split).

⚠ error R04 Variable names match the naming convention

Why it fails. VARNAMES.md convention ^[A-Z0-9]{2}_[0-9]{2}_[A-Z0-9_]+$. Trailing spaces give data columns with invisible spaces in their names; lower case breaks the convention.

How to fix. Rename in variables.csv (variable_name and family_id) and in every xpaths.csv row that uses the name. Log as rename (affects_data TRUE: column names change; the v1 crosswalk records it).

⚠ error TYPE_CHECKBOX Checkbox variable holds non-checkbox values

Why it fails. Under 95% of the values are X/true/false/1/0 (e.g. free-text declarations), so the xpath is not this checkbox.

How to fix. Remap the offending xpath (xpaths.csv variable_name) to a text variable. affects_data TRUE.

▲ warn ONE_REPEATS Repeats within a filing in a one-to-one table

Why it fails. In more than 1% of filings the xpath occurs more than once, but its table keeps one row per filing, so the extra values are dropped.

How to fix. Make the table MANY (tables.csv cardinality) or move the variable to a repeating table (variables.csv table_id, new table in tables.csv). affects_data TRUE.

▲ warn V_POOLED_SCALE Pooled xpaths on different scales (3-10x)

Why it fails. Medians of the variable's xpaths differ 3-10x within one return type. Weaker than SCALE_BREAK (>10x); population changes between schema eras can also cause it.

How to fix. Review the report; remap if the xpaths measure different things.

✎ clean-up R11 Text is valid UTF-8

Why it fails. Windows-1252 curly quotes (bytes 0x93/0x94) are not valid UTF-8 and display as garbage in UTF-8 tools.

How to fix. Replace them with plain or UTF-8 quotes in the listed cell. Log as relabel (affects_data FALSE).
